# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - bioconda::bioconductor-dexseq=1.56.0
  - bioconda::htseq=2.1.2

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process DEXSEQ_COUNT {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_single'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/07/0718f75da083443fe7acb310d3f8ef8216fb4561395226a48fff870d17323f4e/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/bioconductor-dexseq_htseq:4266bf085c9883ac'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(bam)
    tuple val(meta2), path(gff)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.txt"), emit: counts
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('bioconductor-dexseq'), eval('Rscript -e "cat(as.character(packageVersion(\'DEXSeq\')))"'), topic: versions, emit: versions_dexseq
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('htseq'), eval('python -c "import HTSeq; print(HTSeq.__version__)"'), topic: versions, emit: versions_htseq

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def paired = meta.single_end ? 'no' : 'yes'
    // The script ships with the DEXSeq R package and is not on the PATH.
    // With HTSeq 2 it quotes the feature IDs, which DEXSeqDataSetFromHTSeq cannot read.
    """
    dexseq_scripts=\$(Rscript -e 'cat(system.file("python_scripts", package = "DEXSeq"))')

    python \${dexseq_scripts}/dexseq_count.py \\
        --paired ${paired} \\
        --format bam \\
        --order pos \\
        ${args} \\
        ${gff} \\
        ${bam} \\
        ${prefix}.txt

    sed -i 's/"//g' ${prefix}.txt
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}.txt
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/dexseq/count"
description: "Count the reads overlapping the exonic counting bins of a DEXSeq annotation"
keywords:
- "dexseq"
- "exon"
- "count"
- "alternative splicing"
- "differential exon usage"
tools:
- dexseq:
    description: "Inference of differential exon usage in RNA-Seq"
    homepage: "https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/DEXSeq.html"
    documentation: "https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/DEXSeq/inst/doc/DEXSeq.html"
    tool_dev_url: "https://git.bioconductor.org/packages/DEXSeq"
    doi: "10.1101/gr.133744.111"
    licence:
    - "GPL >=3"
    identifier: "biotools:dexseq"
- htseq:
    description: "HTSeq is a Python library to facilitate processing and analysis\
      \ of data from high-throughput sequencing (HTS) experiments."
    homepage: "https://htseq.readthedocs.io/en/latest/"
    documentation: "https://htseq.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html"
    doi: "10.1093/bioinformatics/btu638"
    licence:
    - "GPL v3"
    identifier: "biotools:htseq"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
        \ single_end:false ]`\n"
  - bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "BAM file of the aligned reads, sorted by position. For a BAM sorted\n\
        by name, pass `--order name` through `ext.args`; a mismatched sort\norder\
        \ gives wrong counts without any error.\n"
      pattern: "*.bam"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing annotation information\ne.g. `[ id:'genome'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - gff:
      type: "file"
      description: "Flattened DEXSeq annotation, as created by dexseq/prepareannotation"
      pattern: "*.gff"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2305"
output:
  counts:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1',\
          \ single_end:false ]`\n"
    - '*.txt':
        type: "file"
        description: "Read counts for each exonic counting bin"
        pattern: "*.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  versions_dexseq:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - bioconductor-dexseq:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - Rscript -e "cat(as.character(packageVersion('DEXSeq')))":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  versions_htseq:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - htseq:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python -c "import HTSeq; print(HTSeq.__version__)":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - bioconductor-dexseq:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - Rscript -e "cat(as.character(packageVersion('DEXSeq')))":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - htseq:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python -c "import HTSeq; print(HTSeq.__version__)":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"

- "@piplus2"

- "@piplus2"

    linux/amd64:
      name: "community.wave.seqera.io/library/bioconductor-dexseq_htseq:4266bf085c9883ac"
